why: Compresses at zlib`s default level 6 instead of the 9 the recorded ceilings were measured at, which hands the budget silent headroom: the same bytes measure larger, so the gate reports a bundle closer to its ceiling than it is -- or, after someone re-baselines against the wrong level, further from it. Every other assertion in the suite compares gzipSize against itself and would not notice; only a test that pins the level can.
killedBy: bundle budget: what it measures gzips with zlib level 9, not with whatever the platform defaults to
